## Testing

JUnit is the norm; these exercises use stdout to mirror test assertions.

exercises.title: Basic test (stdout)
Table cases (stdout)
Divide and error (stdout)
exercises.description: Print `ok` if `divide(10,2)` is 5 and `divide(10,0)` is null.

exercises.title: Error message check (stdout)
exercises.description: If `validate(-5)` throws with `negative` in the message, print `yes`.

exercises.title: Hot path loop (stdout)
exercises.description: Call `sum(2,3)` ten thousand times, then print `done`.
